coach_narrative.weekly_mirror: When Sami’s nap schedule was changed without asking you, you were left feeling that your say as his parent had been set aside: "Nobody asked what I thought." Then, after being up with his fever, your mother-in-law’s help brought both care and the feeling of being dismissed.
coach_narrative.tension_explanation: Across these moments, your wish to choose how Sami is cared for sits alongside the family customs and involvement around you. It makes sense that help can feel complicated when it arrives without making space for your voice, though what you wanted to happen next remains unclear.
coach_narrative.reflective_question: When your mother-in-law took over at 5am, what would have helped you feel cared for without feeling dismissed?
